name: OneSpan Sign
agentUseSummary: Connect customer-owned OneSpan Sign OAuth client credentials for one documented environment. Relay exchanges five-minute access tokens server-side and exposes only two fixed privacy-redacted transaction lifecycle reads; broad unscoped provider authority, people, documents, signing, evidence, writes, raw access, pagination, polling, retries, and exports remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated OAuth 2.0 client in the connected OneSpan Sign account.

credentialRequirements.helpText: Select the exact documented regional sandbox or production environment.

capabilities.label: List transactions
capabilities.description: Read a bounded first page of privacy-redacted transaction lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Inspect transaction metadata
capabilities.description: Read privacy-redacted lifecycle metadata for one explicit transaction.

allowed.label: List transactions
allowed.description: List up to 25 first-page transaction lifecycle summaries for one explicit status.

allowed.label: Inspect a transaction
allowed.description: Inspect lifecycle metadata for one explicit transaction ID.

blocked.label: Access private transaction content
blocked.description: Documents, files, evidence, audit data, roles, recipients, signers, messages, fields, signing URLs, authentication data, and signatures are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or sign transactions
blocked.description: Creating, sending, signing, reminding, archiving, deleting, uploading, updating, and administering are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad account authority
blocked.description: OneSpan does not yet provide OAuth scopes; Relay confines the customer-owned credential to two fixed metadata reads and never exposes it to agents.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk APIs
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, automatic retries, batch access, callbacks, webhooks, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only transaction lifecycle
approvalProfiles.description: Two fixed privacy-redacted transaction metadata reads run automatically; OneSpan's currently unscoped account credential remains confined server-side.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Fixed environment, token exchange, paths, strict projection, result cap, and read-only boundary remain enforced.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized account administrator must enable OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, create a dedicated client, copy its one-time secret, and identify the exact OneSpan environment. OneSpan currently offers client credentials only, no scopes, no refresh token, and no delegated user-consent flow. No provider-console, credential, Railway, or live acceptance work is authorized in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized account owner enables client-credentials API access, creates a dedicated client, connects its ID, secret, and exact environment through Relay's encrypted credential flow, then separately verifies token renewal, list/get redaction, credential rotation/replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: OneSpan documents client-credentials-only OAuth, Basic client authentication, POST /oauth2/token, five-minute Bearer access tokens, token reuse, and no refresh functionality.
OneSpan documents customer-admin API access setup and states that OAuth scope capabilities are not yet available.
OneSpan documents GET /api/packages with from, to, and query for bounded transaction lists and GET /api/packages/{packageId} for one transaction.
